items: Exam Question Favorite: Articles 5 to 11 in Part II deal with Citizenship.
Crucial Rule: Dual citizenship is NOT allowed in India.
Power to Legislate: Article 11 empowers Parliament to pass laws regarding citizenship (e.g., Citizenship Act of 1955).

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Part II of the Constitution (Articles 5 to 11) is dedicated to Citizenship.
India strictly practices single citizenship, prohibiting dual citizenship.
The Citizenship Act was enacted in 1955 to regulate citizenship matters.
Article 11 specifically empowers the Parliament to regulate the right of citizenship.
Overseas Citizenship of India (OCI) does not confer status equal to full Indian citizenship.
